policy: Peer-reviewed functional orthology is accepted only when an exact-species gene is independently resolved, the species-specific biological context is experimentally supported, cross-species complementation or equivalent functional evidence explicitly supports orthology, and the selected human target is independently validated. One-to-many relationships must remain explicit.

Caenorhabditis elegans.bridge_scope: endogenous freeze-tolerance mechanism; independent of the exogenous ice-binding-protein intervention
Caenorhabditis elegans.rationale: Exact-species freeze-thaw genetics requires DAF-16 downstream of daf-2, while independent human-to-worm complementation work demonstrates that human FKHRL1/FOXO3 can partially replace DAF-16. This supports a conserved FOXO-family relationship without asserting one-to-one orthology or human clinical efficacy.
